title: 第1450章 食空兽第1449章 老大你说过要来找我的啊
lines: 李卓阳见此，又连忙以磅礴的空间法力将自身包裹，抵抗着空间乱流的冲撞！
但是，李卓阳又不敢彻底离开空间乱流！
毕竟，越是乱流密集的地方，越有可能存在通往外界的空间裂缝！
感受着无数空间乱流拍打到肉身带来的剧痛的同时，他的神识却不断在一道道空间裂缝中搜寻着！
如此一来，不管是法力，还是神识，甚至肉身之力，都在急剧地消耗着。
也不知过了多久，当李卓阳感觉丹田内已经逐渐空虚之际。
终于，他眼前一亮，看到了众多空间裂缝中，有一道似乎可以通往外界！
于是，来不及思索，李卓阳即刻锁定了这道空间裂缝，而后聚集体内最后一丝法力，发动瞬移术，冲入了其中。
不知过了多久，伴随着头脑中一阵疼痛传来，李卓阳终于恢复意识。
然而，其双眼皮此刻却仿佛如山一般沉重，令其难以睁开。
这是哪里？
我落入空间乱流了吗？
李卓阳心头不禁一沉地想到。
不过，过了数息，当他感受到身下凹凸不平的地面带来的一丝不舒适后，终于意识到，他应该是离开了虚空。
只不过，在最后离开时，自己的法力、神识和肉身，皆消耗到了极限，导致眼下极度虚弱罢了。
还好，眼下只是消耗过度带来的虚弱而已，李卓阳感知到自己识海中的元神和丹田等关键并无根基性的损伤时，心中也不由得松了一口气。
这种虚弱，他并不是第一次遇到，只要过不了多久，自己的神识之力恢复稍许后，他便可以借机打开体内空间，将蜂王浆、百花香玉髓、九珍魔元酿直接灌入口中，快速恢复实力了。
然而，心中刚想起这个念头时，李卓阳骤然觉得自己脸上痒痒的。
这种感觉，就像是有什么虫子在自己脸上轻轻爬过一样。
虫子爬就爬吧，自己眼下虽然肉身之力被消耗干涸了，但是肉身强度还是存在的，区区些许虫子，定然是破不开自己的肉身的。
不过，又过了一会儿，李卓阳便感觉到了不妙。
因为那种痒痒的感觉，绝非是什么虫子爬过的感觉，而更像是某种动物的舌头，在舔舐着自己。
感知到此，李卓阳蓦然心头一紧。
虫子破不开的肉身，妖兽便不一定破不开！
若是遇到了某种牙齿极为锋利的妖兽，将自己的脸给吃了，那还怎么有脸见人？
好在，忍了数十息后，李卓阳终于感知到了一丝神识之力从识海诞生，朝着元神汇聚而去。
李卓阳丝毫不敢再等待，也无暇调集百花香玉髓服用，而是第一时间从体内空间召唤出两头五阶噬皇金蜂飞了出来！
content_en:
Seeing this, Li Zhuoyang quickly wrapped himself with the majestic space magic power to resist the collision of the space turbulence!
However, Li Zhuoyang did not dare to completely leave the space turbulence!
After all, the more turbulent the place, the more likely there are spatial cracks leading to the outside world!
"Bang..."
"Bang..."
"Boom..."
While feeling the severe pain caused by countless spatial turbulences hitting his physical body, his consciousness was constantly searching through the cracks in space!
As a result, whether it is mana, spiritual consciousness, or even physical strength, they are all being consumed rapidly.
I don't know how long it took, but Li Zhuoyang felt that his Dantian was gradually empty.
Finally, his eyes lit up and he saw one of the many space cracks that seemed to lead to the outside world!
So, without any time to think, Li Zhuoyang immediately locked onto the space crack, then gathered the last bit of mana in his body, activated the teleportation technique, and rushed into it.
…
I don't know how long it took, but with a burst of pain in his head, Li Zhuoyang finally regained consciousness.
However, his double eyelids seemed as heavy as mountains at the moment, making it difficult for him to open them.
Where is this?
Have I fallen into space turbulence?
Li Zhuoyang couldn't help but think with a heavy heart.
However, after a few breaths passed, when he felt a slight discomfort caused by the uneven ground beneath him, he finally realized that he should have left the void.
However, when he finally left, his mana, consciousness, and body were all exhausted to the limit, resulting in him being extremely weak now.
Fortunately, it was just weakness caused by excessive consumption at the moment. When Li Zhuoyang sensed that there was no fundamental damage to the Yuan Shen and Dantian in his consciousness, he couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief.
This is not the first time he has encountered this kind of weakness. As soon as his spiritual power recovers a little, he can take the opportunity to open the space in his body, pour royal jelly, potpourri chalcedony, and Jiuzhen Demonic Essence Brew directly into his mouth, and quickly regain his strength.
However, just when this thought came to his mind, Li Zhuoyang suddenly felt itchy on his face.
This feeling was like an insect crawling across my face.
Insects can crawl. Although the strength of my physical body has been consumed and dried up, the strength of my physical body still exists. A few insects will definitely not be able to break through my physical body.
However, after a while, Li Zhuoyang felt something was wrong.
Because the itching feeling was definitely not that of an insect crawling over, but more like the tongue of some kind of animal licking itself.
"Oops..."
Upon sensing this, Li Zhuoyang's heart suddenly tightened.
If the insect cannot break the flesh, the monster may not be able to break it!
If you encounter some kind of monster with extremely sharp teeth and eat your face, how can you still have the face to see others?
Fortunately, after enduring for dozens of breaths, Li Zhuoyang finally felt a trace of the power of divine consciousness emerging from the sea of ​​consciousness and gathering towards the soul.
Li Zhuoyang did not dare to wait any longer, and he had no time to gather the chalcedony of flowers to take it. Instead, he immediately summoned two fifth-level Emperor-eating Golden Bees from the space inside his body and flew out!
"Buzzing..."
title_en: Chapter 1450 The Sky-Eating Beast Chapter 1449 Boss, you said you were coming to find me.
